Name: Stardew Valley BGM Framework
Author: Zorkats2
Description:
[center][size=6][b]🎵 Stardew BGM Framework[/b][/size]

[i][b]The audio companion and Content Patcher developer tool for Stardew Valley.[/b][/i][/center]

Stardew BGM Framework is not just a "Now Playing" notification mod. It is a complete [b]Audio Frontend[/b] that bridges the gap between Content Patcher and the player experience. It automatically detects music from other mods (like [i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i] or [i]Ridgeside Village[/i]), organizes them into a library, and lets you listen to them anytime.

Disclaimer: This is my first mod for Stardew, they are gonna be errors and not everything will be perfect. but I hope people like it.


[line]

[size=5]Features for Players[/size]

[size=4] [b]The "Now Playing" Toast[/b][/size]
Never wonder "What song is this?" again.
[list]
[*]Displays Title, Disc/Track Number, and Source (Mod Name).
[*][b]Automatic Detection:[/b] Works with Vanilla music AND modded music instantly.
[*][b]Animated UI:[/b] Smooth slide-in/slide-out animation with a native Stardew Valley look.
[*][b]Streamer Ready:[/b] Can export the current song name to a text file for OBS overlays.
[/list]

[size=4] [b]The Walkman (In-Game Player)[/b][/size]
Turn your game into an MP3 player!
[list]
[*]Press [b]K[/b] (configurable) to open the Framework Menu.
[*]Go to the [b]Player Tab[/b] to browse every song currently loaded in the game.
[*]Click any song to play it instantly, regardless of where you are.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Audio Balancing[/b][/size]
Is a specific modded song too loud?
[list]
[*]Open the [b]Editor[/b] while the song is playing.
[*]Drag the [b]Volume Slider[/b] to fix it.
[*]The mod [b]remembers your setting forever[/b]. No more blown-out ears!
[/list]

[line]

[size=5]Features for Modders (The Dev Tool)[/size]

[size=4][b]The Auto-Gen Engine[/b][/size]
This is the mod's superpower. You do not need to manually register your songs.
[list]
[*]The mod scans Stardew Valley's internal audio data ([i]Data/AudioChanges[/i]) in real-time.
[*]If you add a song via Content Patcher, [b]BGM Framework detects it automatically[/b].
[*]It instantly generates a database entry, formats the ID into a readable title (e.g. [i]forest_theme[/i] -> "Forest Theme"), and makes it available in the library.
[*]Zero configuration required. It just works.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Content Pack Generator[/b][/size]
Stop writing JSON files by hand!
[list=1]
[*][b]Play & Record:[/b] Install your new custom music mod. Run the game. The Auto-Gen Engine will populate the list for you.
[*][b]Edit In-Game:[/b] Press [b]K[/b]. Rename your tracks, add Disc/Track numbers, and fix volume levels.
[*][b]Export:[/b] Click the [b]Export[/b] button.
[*][b]Done:[/b] The mod generates a ready-to-ship Content Patcher pack in your [font=Courier New]Mods/StardewBGMFramework/exported_packs[/font] folder. It includes your metadata and even generates a [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] so users can toggle specific songs!
[/list]
[line]

[size=5] Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url] for easy configuration.
[*]Run the game!
[/list]

[size=5] Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Replay Key (Default: J):[/b] Show the notification again.
[*][b]Edit Mode Key (Default: K):[/b] Open the Dashboard/Walkman.
[*][b]Auto-Unlock Jukebox:[/b] Automatically add every song you hear to your farmhouse Jukebox.
[*][b]Streamer Mode:[/b] Output current song info to [font=Courier New]now_playing.txt[/font].
[/list]

[size=5] Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+ Required.[/b]
[*]Fully compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b], [b]Ridgeside Village[/b], [b]East Scarp[/b], and any mod that uses Content Patcher audio
[/list]
